Concrete scoped directive:

1. Promote the already-proved `thm:smoothness-adaptive-log-free-upper` to the headline contribution. One law-independent algorithm, not using \(s\) or \(r\), attains
\[
C_{s,r}\left(n^{-1-2s/(2s+d)}\vee n^{-1-2r/(2r+d)}\right)
\]
for every fixed \(s,r>0\), without logarithmic loss. The TL;DR, project fill, related work, interpretation, sampling-model summary, theorem consumers, comparator table, and open-question prose currently understate or contradict this result.

2. Add a headline mean-only upper corollary under a law-invariant oracle-allocation condition: if a known measurable \(e^\circ(x)\) minimizes the pointwise generalized Neyman objective for every \(P\) in the model, use \(e^\circ\) directly and omit variance learning. Equation (18) then has zero allocation regret, and the predictable AIPW mean fit gives
\[
\sup_P\left\{E[(T-\theta(P))^2]-\frac{V^*(P)}n\right\}
\le C n^{-1-2s/(2s+d)}.
\]
